editorial:
Imagine waking up in a world where a mysterious sickness has wiped out almost everyone. You are hiding in a house in the middle of the woods with your wife and son, following a strict set of rules just to stay alive. Everything feels tense and quiet until another family shows up begging for help. You have to decide if you can trust these strangers or if letting them in is a death sentence. It is not your typical monster movie with jump scares; instead, it focuses on the fear and stress of not knowing who to believe when the world has ended.

The acting is top-notch and makes the tension feel real. You will love how the movie builds up a feeling of dread, though some might find the slow pace a bit frustrating. If you enjoy stories about human nature and survival, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: The movie ends in a total mess. After a lot of fighting and sickness, the house is set on fire. The father tries to save his son, but the son ends up dying. The father then kills the other family members in a fit of rage and grief. He is left completely alone in the woods with nothing left. The twist is that the real monster was not the disease, but how mean and scared people become to survive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and survival stories.
